_comment_header: DS-EO Supervisor Configuration — Copy to supervisor_config.json and adjust values

supervisor._comment_mode: automatic = full lifecycle; manual = observer only (warns but never auto-recovers)
supervisor._comment_artifact_patterns: File patterns used to detect agent progress. Relative to workspace_root.
supervisor._comment_notification_templates: Optional custom notification templates (use defaults if omitted)

notification_templates.stall_warning: {severity_icon} **Stall Detected** — Agent '{agent_id}' in phase '{phase}' has been idle for {idle_seconds}s
notification_templates.escalation_critical: {severity_icon} **Escalation Required** — Agent stalled after {retry_count} retries. Work completed: {work_completed}/{total_required}
notification_templates.task_aborted: {severity_icon} **Task Aborted** — {work_completed} of {total_required} deliverables produced before abort.

_validation_rules._comment: Runtime validation rules. Invalid configs produce clear errors at startup.
_validation_rules._comment_derivation: Derived constraints: heartbeat_interval <= no_progress_timeout / 4; hard_timeout >= no_progress_timeout + max(retry_backoff)
